text: Thalidomide acts as a molecular glue that binds to the Cereblon (CRBN) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, altering its substrate specificity. This interaction induces the recruitment and subsequent proteasomal degradation of specific transcription factors, such as Ikaros (IKZF1) and Aiolos (IKZF3), which are essential for the survival and proliferation of Multiple Myeloma cells.
